degree_rationale: What Love and Hate are — Love = bond of Greatness binding the Father and his aeons; Hate = first death gushing from darkness, source of envy/devil/evil. Treats the operative essence of the two great affective principles.
direction_rationale: The completing definition of cosmic affective forces — love bound, hate genealogy named. Settled meaning.
grand_man_function: Spiritual affective seal — Love and Hate in their cosmic operation.
title: What love is and what hate is, in their cosmic origin
